compact.guidance: Small steps between sizes. Use weight and color, not size, to separate levels.

balanced.guidance: Moderate steps. Headings are clearly larger without dominating.

expressive.guidance: Noticeable steps. Headlines can lead the page.

dramatic.guidance: Large steps. Let the headline be the most visible thing on the page, and keep everything below it quiet.

low.guidance: Hierarchy comes from size and space, not boldness.

medium.guidance: Headings are firm but not heavy. Avoid bold body text.

high.guidance: Headings are bold and confident. Use bold only for headings and primary actions.

inverted.guidance: Display type is lighter than body. Use size, not weight, to create hierarchy, and only at large sizes.

compact.guidance: Favor information over air. Tables and lists over cards. Keep related items 8px apart and separate groups by at least 44px.

comfortable.guidance: Balanced. Cards and lists both work. Separate groups clearly, at least 48px.

spacious.guidance: Fewer things per screen, each given room. Separate groups by at least 56px.

reading.guidance: Optimized for long text. Never exceed 68 characters per line. Separate sections by at least 64px.

always: More space above a heading than below it.
Actions sit close to what they act on.
Never use equal gaps between unrelated groups.

none.guidance: Square corners everywhere. Precise and formal.

slight.guidance: Nearly square. Softens edges without reading as rounded.

subtle.guidance: Gently rounded. Panels and buttons should look related but not identical.

soft.guidance: Clearly rounded and friendly. Keep it consistent across all components.

round.guidance: Very rounded. Use the larger radius only on large surfaces, never on small controls.

none.guidance: Separate areas with space and surface color, not lines.

hairline.guidance: 1px low-contrast lines. Use for dividing rows and outlining panels.

rule.guidance: 1px full-strength lines. Use as structure, like a newspaper, not as decoration.

flat.guidance: No shadows. Separate layers with surface color or borders.

soft.guidance: One diffuse shadow for floating elements only, such as menus and dialogs.

layered.guidance: Two shadow levels: one for cards, one for floating elements. Never shadow and border on the same element.

snappy.guidance: Fast and precise. 100ms for small changes, 180ms for navigation, ease-out, no overshoot.

smooth.guidance: Calm and considered. 200ms for small changes, 320ms for navigation, ease-in-out.

springy.guidance: Playful and physical. Gentle overshoot on buttons and toggles only, never on page transitions.

none.guidance: No animation. State changes are instant.

always: Respect reduced-motion settings: under prefers-reduced-motion, all motion is off.
Animate only what the user caused, plus at most one moment on load.
The primary action is the most visible element on the page. Nothing else uses the accent at the same strength.
Status colors mean status only. Never use them for decoration.
Muted text is for supporting information, never for anything the user must read to act.
color.fill_only: Never use the accent color for text.
